title: Card
description: A unique card (name + pitch), per plan section 5.1. Printings are collapsed; foiling is a property of a drafted instance, not the card.

uid.description: Stable identifier for this unique card (name + pitch), e.g. 'IAR166-red'.

pitch.description: 1=red, 2=yellow, 3=blue; null for cards with no pitch value (e.g. heroes, weapons). Not restricted to 1-3: some special cards (e.g. Fabled 'Soul' resources) use other values (confirmed against real IAR data) - never clamp or reject an unusual pitch value.

rarity.description: Basic, Common, Rare, Majestic, Legendary, Marvel, Fabled. Mapped explicitly from source data, never guessed (plan section 5.1).

cost.description: Numeric resource cost. Cards with a variable cost (X, etc.) are a known ingestion gap - see docs/status/WP-01.md.

specialization.description: Hero name if this card's text contains a Specialization restriction.

object_type.description: Authoritative category, mirroring the real card database's own object_type (deck-card/arena-card/hero-card/token). 'deck' = counts toward the 30-card deck; 'arena' = weapon/equipment, registered separately; 'hero' = a hero (also an arena card per the plan glossary, but never appears in a booster pack regardless of its own rarity - see fabdraft_core.packs.generator); 'token' = created during play, never drafted or deck-built. is_deck_card/is_arena_card below are derived conveniences and are NOT complementary: a hero or token has both false.

draftable.description: Default/example draftability for this printing (e.g. false for a Basic-rarity or expansion-slot Majestic). The pack generator (WP-05) computes the *actual* draftability of a given drafted instance from the slot it came from, which can override this - see fabdraft_core.packs.generator.

is_expansion_slot.description: True for a Majestic printed only in the expansion (non-core) subset of the set (plan S13). Derivation is source-specific: the-fab-cube dataset exposes printings[].expansion_slot directly; Card Vault exports don't, so it's inferred from a contiguous high set-number block (confirmed against real IAR data: set numbers 243-262 are exactly the 20 expansion Majestics). False for every other card. Used by the pack generator to keep expansion-slot Majestics out of every draftable pack slot (S13).

data_complete.description: False on any card with a missing required field; loading a set with incomplete cards requires --allow-incomplete (WP-02).
